english:
First of all, I thank Jesus and the Blessed Mother with a heart full of gratitude. I am coming from Vellayankudi parish, from Idukki district, Vellayankudi parish.
In 2022, we came to know that both kidneys of my husband had failed. At that time, I came here.
I took the Covenant prayer, and in 2023 my husband underwent a transplant without any complications, and it was completely successful. Again, I came here in between.
I renewed the Covenant prayer once more. After that, for about two to two and a half years, my husband had no health issues at all. After that,
in November 2025, my husband was affected by jaundice again. Due to jaundice, he was admitted to the same hospital again. He was admitted for about one month.
During that time, they did a bone marrow test, then an endoscopy, and took a sample from the liver and sent it for biopsy. From that, we came to know that there was cancer.
Everything became very difficult. They told us that he should not take any medicines there, that the kidney now needs to be protected, and that treatment should be focused on cancer.
Saying this, they referred us to the MVR Cancer Center in Kozhikode. After that, we went there again.
When we went there, they said that a PET scan should be done. They said that if nothing is seen in the PET scan, or if nothing significant is found inside,
then an open surgery of the liver would have to be done. In this way, we got the PET scan date on January 3rd.
After going for the PET scan and completing it, on the same day, the doctor told us that there was no problem at all.
Before that, I had prayed to the Mother. I had applied the Covenant oil on my husband’s chest and prayed, and only then we went for the PET scan.
At that time, I told the Mother that if there is no problem at all in the scanning, I will come here again and renew my Covenant.
And so, after the scan, they said there was no problem at all. The doctor told us that he does not need to take any medicines and that we can go home.
And so we returned. After that, we again went to Iqraa Hospital, the same hospital in Kozhikode where my husband’s kidney transplant was done.
When we went there, they told us that from now on, you do not need to take any kidney medicines at all. You only need to take one small tablet; apart from that,
there were many tablets earlier, and they told us that you do not need to use those anymore. Then they said that we should come once a month for check-up.
So truly, Jesus worked a great miracle for us. With deep gratitude to Jesus and the Blessed Mother, I end my words. As much as I am able to, I do missionary works.
At home, it is my husband, myself, and our three children. Also, every day we go to church, and then we visit elderly mothers and nearby sick people.
Then, as much as possible, we also do good deeds to help others.
Holy Gospel according to Saint Matthew, Chapter 14, Verse 36: "They begged Him to let them touch even the edge of His garment,
and all who touched Him were healed." Siji has given this great testimony here for her life partner Thomas.
This brother Thomas is a person who has undergone kidney transplantation. While they were still in the Covenant, after a short time,
when they perhaps moved away from the Covenant, they again faced a life crisis, and once more they renewed the Covenant and prayed very powerfully.
They came to understand that he was affected by the disease called cancer. Cancer, like the major illnesses that weaken our lives, that break us down and crush us,
even for such serious diseases that today are judged as incurable and without healing even with medicines, through the Blessed Mother here,
by using the covenant items received from here, through the intercession of the Blessed Mother, Jesus healed them, and for this great testimony,
let us thank Jesus and the Blessed Mother. When they leave from here after renewing the Covenant, this sister gave a word to the Mother.
She said: If this comes as a healing, if without surgery and without treatment You lead us into healing, then certainly,
we will come here and stand before the Holy presence of the Mother and give testimony.
When she came here saying that she would be a witness for Jesus, crying aloud and praying with a heavy heart, God who collected all their tears in a bottle
has blessed them to come joyfully before this Holy presence, with great rejoicing, to thank Jesus and the Blessed Mother.
We know that for all those who live the Covenant faithfully, the Covenant conditions are nothing other than the commandments that Jesus has given us.
The first commandment is: Worship the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength, and likewise,
the great commandment to love your neighbor as yourself. When we live according to this great commandment of love, is the law.
Love is the law of the Lord. The moment we break that love, that is where we move away from Jesus. Never moving away from Jesus,
and always living under the protection of the intercession and prayers of the Blessed Mother for us, this testimony reminds us that healing is assured for us.
Keeping all children affected by cancer united with this testimony, remembering all our intentions in prayer,
uniting these intentions with this testimony, for the great healing received by Thomas, let us thank Jesus and the Blessed Mother.
Let us offer this testimony by giving a warm round of applause to Jesus and the Blessed Mother.
